description: Defines the 'decimal' field type class for Drupal, including storage settings, schema, form elements, and sample value generation.

classes.name: DecimalItem
classes.description: Defines the 'decimal' field type for Drupal, extending NumericItemBase, with methods for storage settings, schema, form configuration, and sample data generation.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings with precision 10 and scale 2, merged with parent settings.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the 'value' property as a required decimal data type.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Provides database schema for the decimal field with precision and scale.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds form elements for configuring precision and scale, with constraints and descriptions.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Adjusts min/max step values based on scale for the field settings form.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Rounds the value to the specified scale before saving.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample decimal value based on field settings, with randomization within min/max bounds.

methods.name: getDecimalDigits
methods.description: Calculates the number of decimal digits in a number.
